scope: Independent raster review of five actual final aad captures; no full UI or acceptance inferred

findings.problem: The 430px table min-content propagates through the grid track; both list and editor exceed the document width.
findings.userImpact: Horizontal document scrolling is needed to read and operate fields.
findings.correction: Constrain grid children and make the table scroll within its own list region, preserving type and input sizes.
findings.observed: New 390px raster keeps page/editor/actions within document; the wide table is confined to its list region. Actual local horizontal scrolling and geometry are separate runtime evidence.

normalPcObservations.rationality: Search criteria/results, selected employee and per-career/overall save scopes are distinguishable.
normalPcObservations.consistency: Shared header/navigation, section headings above content, input/button styles and role sizing are consistent in the inspected views.
normalPcObservations.readability: Labels and field contents are legible; no overlap or clipped normal-state values in the inspected PC captures.
normalPcObservations.operability: Primary save/cancel actions and inline history actions are identifiable in full-page captures; keyboard reachability is a separate runtime check.

notVerified: Any subsequent publish; re-review required if inspected resources change
